note: Chapter 1 is keyed from 'Osimhen lays' (the lay-off) through 'Khvicha Kvaratskhelia' (first touch), 'one defender', 'two', 'three' (the three beats) to 'bang' (the shot) and 'roof of the net': keep the pause at '...' so the slalom plays near real time. Chapter 2 keys the fake to 'He shimmies' and the real cut to 'then right'.

chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Naples, 2023, against Atalanta. Osimhen lays it off to Khvicha Kvaratskhelia on the left. He slaloms past one defender, two, three... bang, into the roof of the net!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. Tiny touches keep the ball close, so no defender can reach it. He shimmies left, then right. Which way?

chapters.label: The finish
chapters.text: Then a quick shift to his right foot, and a thumping shot, high into the net! Fans call him Kvaradona.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: keep the ball close with small touches, so defenders can't reach it.
